about_hero_tagline: Server browser & mod manager for DayZ Standalone
about_updates_done_hint: The installer is launching — the app will restart automatically.
about_qs_step1_body: Click your name (or "Set up account") in the title bar to configure your player name, Steam credentials, and API keys.
about_qs_step2_body: This is the character name passed as -name= when launching DayZ.
about_qs_step3_body: Use the Servers tab to find a server. Double-click a row or click Connect to launch DayZ directly.
about_steamcmd_desc: A command-line tool from Valve used to download Steam Workshop content without the full Steam client. The app uses it to install and update DayZ mods in the background. If the title bar shows {notFound}, install it below or set the path manually in account settings.
about_steamcmd_win_desc: SteamCMD will be downloaded from Valve and installed to
about_mod_step1: Connect to a server — the app offers to install any missing mods automatically.
about_mod_step2: Go to the Mods tab and click Check updates to see which mods are outdated.
about_mod_step3: Click Update N to update all stale mods in one batch, or update them individually.
about_sharing_desc: Share a server with friends by copying a {url} URL or exporting a {file} file from the Direct Connect tab. When someone opens the link or file, the app automatically fills in the server address, queries for live info, and offers to install any missing mods before connecting.
about_sharing_urls_desc: Compact links that encode a server address, mods, and optional password. Ideal for sharing in Discord, forums, or anywhere you can paste a link.
about_sharing_param_qport: Query port for A2S (falls back to heuristics if omitted)
about_sharing_files_desc: A small JSON file containing the full server config including mod names. Double-click one to open it in the app, or use the {button} button in the Direct Connect tab to create one.
about_sharing_dc_step1: Query a server in the Direct Connect tab (or press D on a server in the list).
about_sharing_dc_step2: Click Copy URL to copy a dzch:// link to the clipboard, or Export .dzch to save a file.
about_sharing_dc_step3: Send the link or file to friends — they open it and the app handles the rest.
about_profile_export_desc: Save settings, favorites, history to a {file} file (zstd-compressed, portable between machines).
about_profile_import_desc: Restore a previously exported {file} file. Overwrites current profile and mod list.
about_profile_reset_desc: Wipe profile back to factory defaults — clears all settings, favorites, history and launch options. Installed mods on disk are not affected.
about_tip_auth_step3: Return to rename menu and rename back, apply
about_tip_perf_desc: The launcher may be slower while the progress bar on the Servers tab is visible (pinging servers in background).
profile_import_confirm_message: This will overwrite your current profile, favorites, history and launch options. The app will restart to apply the changes. Continue?
profile_reset_message: This will delete all settings, favorites, history, cached server lists, and launch options — as if the app was never launched. Mods downloaded to your Steam workshop folder are not affected. The app will restart and the setup wizard will reappear.
about_tab_servers_desc: Live server list with search, filters and sortable table.
about_tab_favorites_desc: Starred servers with live counts and ping.
about_tab_history_desc: Previously joined servers with timestamps and live stats.
about_tab_mods_desc: Manage Workshop mods — check, update, and clean up via SteamCMD.
about_tab_news_desc: Latest DayZ news from the official website.
about_tab_offline_desc: Community Offline Mode — solo missions without a server.

about_api_steam_avatar_desc: Steam profile picture in the title bar.
about_api_steam_mods_desc: Workshop API queries at higher rate limits.
about_api_bm_hint: Rankings · uptime · distance · 24 h player graph
